description: Translate the transcript, subtitles (timecodes kept), summary or action items of a completed job into another language. Returns at once; the result appears in get_job under "translations".

job_id.description: job_id returned by transcribe_url or create_upload.

robot_key.description: The robot_key you received with your first job. Required to read or start your jobs.

source.description: What to translate. Default "txt". summary / action_items must exist first.

target_language.description: Language name in English, e.g. "German", "Brazilian Portuguese", "Japanese".

name: translate
title: Translate a result
